_comment: The push entry point of .github/workflows/run_on_mac.yaml. Editing this file and pushing launches a run on GitHub's Apple-silicon runner -- the way in for a branch whose workflow file has not reached master yet, where workflow_dispatch does not exist. Once it has, prefer the dispatch: it leaves no commit behind. See agent_guidance/gpu_harnesses.md.
command: echo '=== ARM A: write-pass pair compaction OFF'; (ALGAN_RASTER_WRITE_COMPACT=0 uv run python benchmarks/performance/nn_scene_PREVIEW.py || echo STEP_FAILED_PREVIEW_NOCOMPACT); echo '=== ARM B: default (compaction on)'; (uv run python benchmarks/performance/nn_scene_PREVIEW.py || echo STEP_FAILED_PREVIEW_DEFAULT)
